gloss: temple or shrine seal; red-ink stamp

definitions.gloss: temple or shrine seal; red-ink stamp of visitation
definitions.explanation: A calligraphic inscription with a red seal stamp given at Buddhist temples and Shinto shrines as proof of one's visit. Typically written by hand in ink with the temple or shrine name, the date, and the deity's name, accompanied by a vermillion seal.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{御朱印|ごしゅいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I received a shrine seal stamp at this shrine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{御朱印帳|ごしゅいんちょう}→御朱印帳：23030_goshuinchou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧しまった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦いただいた→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: I forgot my seal stamp book, so I received it on a separate sheet of paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{御朱印|ごしゅいん}{集|あつ}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧、⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, more people have taken up collecting shrine and temple stamps as a hobby, and at popular temples there are sometimes long lines.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Originally given as proof that a pilgrim had copied and offered a sutra at a temple, {御朱印|ごしゅいん} have become popular souvenirs for shrine and temple visitors. Each one is unique, featuring hand-brushed calligraphy and the distinctive red seal of the institution. Collecting them in a dedicated ⟦{御朱印帳|ごしゅいんちょう}→御朱印帳：23030_goshuinchou⟧ (stamp book) has become a widespread hobby.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {御朱印|ごしゅいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧ / ⟦いただく→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧ (to receive a seal stamp)
- ⟦{御朱印帳|ごしゅいんちょう}→御朱印帳：23030_goshuinchou⟧ (seal stamp book)
- {御朱印|ごしゅいん}{集|あつ}め (seal stamp collecting)
- ⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧{御朱印|ごしゅいん} (limited-edition seal stamp)

USAGE:
The fee for a {御朱印|ごしゅいん} is typically 300-500 yen. It is considered rude to collect them purely as souvenirs without actually visiting the shrine or temple with respect.
